reason: No auto-billing means I'd happily start the 14-day trial, but when it asks me to pay on day 14 I'd pick the free version or go back to YouTube. On $9,000 a year I don't pay monthly for sleep sounds when free ones already work well enough.
objection: YouTube sleep music is free and plays all night. I'd be paying for a timer that fades out and a resume button, and the app's own record telling me I fall asleep a few minutes faster isn't proof enough to spend money every month.
would_change_my_mind: If after 14 days my record showed a big drop, like falling asleep 20+ minutes faster, and there was a cheap one-time or student price around 2,000 won a month.
